CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

2. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

4. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

6. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

7. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

13. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

15. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
